camel_example: aliyun ons OnsGroupList --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key CartService --GroupType tcp --InstanceId MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --Tag.1.Value ServiceA --GroupId GID_test_group_id
description_en: Queries all Group IDs of a specified instance
description_zh: 查询指定实例下所有的Group ID信息
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-group-list --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --group-id GID_test_group_id --group-type tcp --tag Value=ServiceA Key=CartService --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsGroupList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID corresponding to the Group ID for which you want to retrieve the resources
parameters.help_zh: 需获取资源列表的Group ID所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The Group ID used for fuzzy match. If you specify this parameter, a fuzzy match is performed. Otherwise, all Group IDs are queried.

If you specify GID_ABC, a fuzzy match is performed, and all Group IDs that contain \GID_ABC\ are returned, such as GID_test_GID_ABC_123 and GID_ABC_356
parameters.help_zh:
模糊查询指定Group ID时设置，否则查询所有Group ID。

如果输入GID_ABC查询，那么会以前后缀匹配的方式进行模糊查询，返回所有包含\GID_ABC\的Group ID，例如GID_test_GID_ABC_123、GID_ABC_356
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol applicable to the Group ID. Group IDs for TCP and HTTP protocols cannot be shared and must be created separately. Valid values:

tcp: the default value. This value indicates that the Group ID is applicable only to message publishing and consumption over TCP.
http: This value indicates that the Group ID is applicable only to message publishing and consumption over HTTP
parameters.help_zh:
查询的Group ID适用的协议。TCP协议和HTTP协议的Group ID不可以共用，需要分别创建。取值说明如下：

tcp：默认值，表示该Group ID仅适用于TCP协议的消息收发。
http：表示该Group ID仅适用于HTTP协议的消息收发
parameters.name: group_type

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the Group ID. You must specify both Key and Value or leave both empty. If you specify both, the system filters Group IDs based on the tag. If you leave both empty, all Group IDs are queried.

If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.
The value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
Group ID的标签键。Key和Value值必须同时输入或同时不输入。若同时输入表示根据Tag过滤符合条件的Group ID，若不输入表示查询所有Group ID。

如果输入该值，则取值不允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the Group ID. You must specify both Key and Value or leave both empty. If you specify both, the system filters Group IDs based on the tag. If you leave both empty, all Group IDs are queried.

If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string.
The value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
Group ID的标签值。Key和Value值必须同时输入或同时不输入。若同时输入表示根据Tag过滤符合条件的Group ID，若不输入表示查询所有Group ID。

如果输入该值，取值允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags bound to the Group IDs. You can specify a maximum of 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: Group ID所绑定的标签列表。列表元素个数不得超过 20
parameters.name: tag

RequestId.description_en: The common parameter. The ID of each request is unique and active for troubleshooting and locating issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
